summary: Zero product-code delta on this branch; the only src/ changes in the evidence gap come from upstream PR 405 (31d84833), already an ancestor of origin/main. The 17 deleted e2e files provably executed nothing (node:test/node:assert only, zero spawn/fs/require hits), so no runtime, schema or persisted-state surface moves. The new CI lint is genuinely fail-closed and passes at HEAD against 66 files including the e2e file that arrived post-evidence from PR 405. Revert is a clean single-commit-range operation. The prior round asymmetric-disclosure block is resolved by a git-tracked unit-observation record with a reciprocal amendment to the e2e record.

findings.detail: A revert is structurally clean but would also undo the two rewrites in test/e2e/story-vibepro-execution-judgment-status-integrity-main.test.js and test/e2e/story-vibepro-managed-worktree-gate-main.test.js, reinstating vacuous versions and re-opening the src/execution-state.js deriveCompletedPhases and src/managed-worktree-gate.js bypassed-branch gaps (VET-S-3/VET-S-4). A rollback should be scoped to the lint/CI step alone if the trigger is a lint false positive.

scripts/lint-e2e-product-execution.mjs matches module specifiers and call names via regex, so a single unused repo-internal import clears it. Disclosed honestly in CHANGELOG.md as a structural tripwire, not proof of behavioural coverage.

The unit-discard decision record states the failing first run raw log was overwritten by the runner and cannot be reconstructed; the flake judgment rests on the static fact that the change set does not reach test/codex-subagent-host.test.js plus a same-head passing rerun. Marked as a limit rather than proof.

inspection.summary: Re-derived blast radius: git diff --name-only against merge-base for src/ and bin/ returned EMPTY; git merge-base --is-ancestor 31d84833 origin/main true; git log 3be3ed55..HEAD -- src/ bin/ lists only 31d84833. For all 17 deleted files, git show origin/main returned only node:test and node:assert imports with 0 hits for spawn, execSync, child_process, readFile, require(, process.argv, fetch(. Dangling-reference grep found no spec pointing at a deleted path. Ran node scripts/lint-e2e-product-execution.mjs exit 0 over 66 files; node --test test/e2e-product-execution-lint.test.js 11/11 pass including fail-closed cases; npm run typecheck exit 0. Read both disclosure records in full. Did NOT run the full unit or e2e suites, which were forbidden this round.

judgment_delta: Initial concern: 17 test deletions plus a new fail-closed CI gate, with unit/e2e evidence bound two merges behind HEAD, is the classic shape of a release that green-lights on stale evidence -> final pass, because the stale-evidence window is provably inert for this branch: the gap contains exactly one src-touching commit, 31d84833, already on origin/main and validated by main's own CI, and the branch's own product diff against merge-base is empty. Verified the one interaction the stale binding could hide, namely that the spec added by PR 405 after the e2e evidence head is covered by the lint run at HEAD over 66 files exit 0.
